row: United Animal Rescue (UAR) is CA non profit organization 501 c (3). UAR saves stray animals in Brazil. Brazil has one of the most largest stray population in the world and weakest legislation in animal sector. We rescue injured, abused, sick animals from street and giving them a chance to start a better life 2.0. We create castrations and vaccinations campaign among poor communities by offering free castration and vaccines for stray animals only and low income families. You can participate by donating to our organization or buy sharing our videos that others can get more familiar with lives of stray animals in Brazil. We believe that world can help Brazil by providing a financial assistance in castration and vaccinations of stray animals. There are 30+ million strays here. Please help these forgotten animals to have a better life. Vaccinations and castrations limit animals struggles. You can donate directly to United Animal rescue through PayPal: donations@unitedanimalrescue.com
